Scoring kills in either mode triggers a 7.5 meter radius <void/>Void explosion, dealing <pve 239 /> <pvp [?] /> damage and spawning a Radiolaria Pool at the target's location. Pool deals <pve 123 /> <pvp [?] /> <arc/>Arc damage in a 3 meter radius once per second for 5 seconds.

Kills needed to spawn a Radiolaria Pool based on <link Combatant Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 3
• Elites and Higher: 1
• Players: ?

While not Aiming Down Sights:
Firing this gun consumes 5 ammo and launches a slow-traveling projectile, splitting into a plus (+) shaped volley of five projectiles after 7.5 meters. Projectiles deal splash damage in a ? meter radius, despawn after 100 meters, and cannot deal precision damage.

Hitting an enemy with the projectile before it splits deals <pve 947 /> <pvp [233] /> damage in a 3 meter radius. 

Split projectiles individually deal <pve 187 /> <pvp [49] /> damage each, totalling for <pve 985 /> <pvp [245] /> damage in a 3 meter radius.
